en.quote: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that were with him in the ward of his lord's house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?
en.riddle: Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?
en.speaker: Joseph

he.quote: וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת־סְרִיסֵי פַרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בְמִשְׁמַר בֵּית אֲדֹנָיו לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ פְּנֵיכֶם רָעִים הַיּֽוֹם
he.speaker: יוסף

en.quote: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:
